data.name: Wreck Sighted
data.description: The black ship that hung over the coast for decades has finally come down. Go and see what it left on the shore.
data.successDescription: You have your first chart. Run it from the Battle Arena, then go to the Wreck for more.

objectives.description:
Word comes down the coast road: the Ghost Ship is down. It lies broken on the sand below the cliffs, and its crew are still aboard, still standing their watch.

A salvager pushes a wet, salt-stained chart into your hands. "Took it off the wreck," she says. "The ship keeps changing inside. A chart only works while it still holds that shape. Don't sit on it."

It is a Tide Chart, marking where the low tide opens the wreck's lower hull.

The crew carry charts like this one, and the Skyglass Wreck gives them up. Each chart opens a treasure run in the Battle Arena, and is spent when the run starts.

Health and chakra carry from fight to fight, with no refills, and a lost fight ends the run. On some runs, at the last landing you choose: leave with what you hold, or press on for more. Lose after pressing on and you keep only what you held.

Clear the Wreck for more charts, and better ones.
The chart is yours. The Wreck waits on the shore: a dungeon for three, with a lighter version for level 45 and up.
